- `@xterm/addon-fit@0.10.0`: `package/lib/addon-fit.js`, `package/LICENSE`.
  npm tarball integrity: `sha512-UFYkDm4HUahf2lnEyHvio51TNGiLK66mqP2JoATy7hRZeXaGMRDr00JiSF7m63vR5WKATF605yEggJKsw0JpMQ==`

When updating, fetch the exact package metadata and tarball from `https://registry.npmjs.org`, verify its SHA-512 integrity, and copy only these files. Keep version and integrity records in this file in sync.
